env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

cd w
logos build -o $WORK/lib.a ./lib
go tool pack p $WORK/lib.a __.LOGOS
stdout '^fn Wide ParamMutated=10000000000000000$'
stdout '^const WidePure P64$'

logos build -o $WORK/ok.a ./okcall
! logos build -o $WORK/bad.a ./badcall
stderr 'const_view_mutation.*cannot pass const view'

# Go-mode mutation masks keep positions 64 and 65: a const view passed at a
# mutated position past 63 is rejected, and one at an unmutated position is not.
cd ../wgo
logos build -o $WORK/wgo.a .
go tool pack p $WORK/wgo.a __.LOGOS
stdout '^fn Wide64 ParamMutated=10000000000000000$'
stdout '^fn Wide65 ParamMutated=20000000000000000$'
cd ../wimp
logos build -o $WORK/wok.a ./ok
! logos build -o $WORK/wbad64.a ./bad64
stderr 'const_view_mutation.*parameter p64'
! logos build -o $WORK/wbad65.a ./bad65
stderr 'const_view_mutation.*parameter p65'
cd ..

-- w/go.mod --
module example.com/wideparams

go 1.27

-- w/logos.toml --
[lints.thresholds]
max_function_params = 70

-- w/lib/lib.lgo --
package lib

func Wide(p0, p1, p2, p3, p4, p5, p6, p7, p8, p9, p10, p11, p12, p13, p14, p15, p16, p17, p18, p19, p20, p21, p22, p23, p24, p25, p26, p27, p28, p29, p30, p31, p32, p33, p34, p35, p36, p37, p38, p39, p40, p41, p42, p43, p44, p45, p46, p47, p48, p49, p50, p51, p52, p53, p54, p55, p56, p57, p58, p59, p60, p61, p62, p63, p64 []int) int {
	p64[0] = 1
	return p64[0]
}

func WidePure(p0, p1, p2, p3, p4, p5, p6, p7, p8, p9, p10, p11, p12, p13, p14, p15, p16, p17, p18, p19, p20, p21, p22, p23, p24, p25, p26, p27, p28, p29, p30, p31, p32, p33, p34, p35, p36, p37, p38, p39, p40, p41, p42, p43, p44, p45, p46, p47, p48, p49, p50, p51, p52, p53, p54, p55, p56, p57, p58, p59, p60, p61, p62, p63 []int, p64 const []int) int {
	return len(p64) + len(p0)
}

	return lib.WidePure(plain, plain, plain, plain, plain, plain, plain, plain, plain, plain, plain, plain, plain, plain, plain, plain, plain, plain, plain, plain, plain, plain, plain, plain, plain, plain, plain, plain, plain, plain, plain, plain, plain, plain, plain, plain, plain, plain, plain, plain, plain, plain, plain, plain, plain, plain, plain, plain, plain, plain, plain, plain, plain, plain, plain, plain, plain, plain, plain, plain, plain, plain, plain, plain, cv)
}

	return lib.Wide(plain, plain, plain, plain, plain, plain, plain, plain, plain, plain, plain, plain, plain, plain, plain, plain, plain, plain, plain, plain, plain, plain, plain, plain, plain, plain, plain, plain, plain, plain, plain, plain, plain, plain, plain, plain, plain, plain, plain, plain, plain, plain, plain, plain, plain, plain, plain, plain, plain, plain, plain, plain, plain, plain, plain, plain, plain, plain, plain, plain, plain, plain, plain, plain, cv)
}
